---
name: Rule proposal
about: Change the method, with the observation behind it.
labels: rule
---

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#a-rule-of-the-method) first.

**Rule**: one imperative sentence.

**Evidence**: what you observed, in which kind of project, how many times. "None" is allowed; say so.

**Check**: the test, hook or gate that would enforce it, if one can.

**Cost**: the human attention it adds or saves.
